description: This circular walk explores the area to the north west of the Bedfordshire village of Caddington. Starting from the village you'll follow footpaths north west towards Blows Downs which sits on the southern edge of neighbouring Dunstable. From the elevated spot there are some fine views over the surrounding Chiltern Hills and down to the town below. You continue through some pleasant countryside with views towards Luton to the east. After your walk you can relax in The Chequers Pub, Caddington. The 18th century pub is in a fine location overlooking the village green. It is dog friendly.
